entries.description: Audited current app dependencies against the simplified notes-driven library handoff and captured remaining compatibility-era usage in docs/planning/notes-driven-app-dependency-audit.md.

Created the Session 1 migration map in docs/planning/notes-driven-app-dependency-audit.md, incorporating routed documentation output plus verifier feedback about report controls and deprecated-surface coverage.
Recorded the pages and layouts still carrying pre-simplification assumptions in docs/session-sets/notes-driven-app-alignment/alignment-baseline.md for Session 2 and Session 3 follow-on work.

Ran dotnet build and dotnet test for Dabbler.Platform.sln. The first pass hit transient file locks from shared build/test hosts, so the build servers were shut down and validation was rerun with node reuse disabled; build then succeeded and all 358 tests passed.
Ran mandatory external session verification and saved the raw review to session-reviews/session-001.md.
